query:
SELECT id, modified_at
            FROM agent_session
            WHERE ($1::timestamptz IS NULL OR modified_at >= $1)
              AND ($2::timestamptz IS NULL OR modified_at < $2)
              AND (
                $3::timestamptz IS NULL
                OR $4::uuid IS NULL
                OR (modified_at, id) > ($3, $4)
              )
            ORDER BY modified_at ASC, id ASC
            LIMIT $5
